messages.content: Transcribe only the attached project drawing annotation. Do not use tools, outside sources, expected values or engineering inference. Return JSON with verbatim_annotation, object_mark, diameter_literal, service_literal, temperature_literal, flow_literal, pressure_literal and reading_uncertainties. Preserve printed digits and units exactly. If any character is unreadable, state that uncertainty rather than guessing. This is literal reading, not a defect verdict.
Read the single annotation in the supplied image. The image was rendered directly from its PDF graphic and rotated for legibility; no OCR text is supplied.
